title: GitLab CI+packaging: Reenable Falco plugins on Windows
description:
Reenable the gcpaudit and k8saudit plugins. Make the plugin path a
variable.

changes_data.diff:
@@ -922,8 +922,8 @@ SetOutPath '$INSTDIR\plugins\${MAJOR_VERSION}.${MINOR_VERSION}\epan'

 SetOutPath '$INSTDIR\plugins\falco'
 File "${STAGING_DIR}\plugins\falco\cloudtrail.dll"
-; File "${STAGING_DIR}\plugins\falco\gcpaudit.dll"
-; File "${STAGING_DIR}\plugins\falco\k8saudit.dll"
+File "${STAGING_DIR}\plugins\falco\gcpaudit.dll"
+File "${STAGING_DIR}\plugins\falco\k8saudit.dll"

     CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY: "Wireshark Foundation"
+    WIRESHARK_BASE_DIR: "$CI_PROJECT_DIR/../wireshark-third-party"
+    FALCO_PLUGIN_DIR: "$WIRESHARK_BASE_DIR/macos-universal-master/lib/falco/plugins"

     - wireshark-macos-arm-package

   script:

-    - export "WIRESHARK_BASE_DIR=${CI_PROJECT_DIR}/../wireshark-third-party"

+      -DFALCO_PLUGINS="$FALCO_PLUGIN_DIR/libcloudtrail.so"
       -DTEST_EXTRA_ARGS=--enable-release
       ..
